how_to_apply: Visit the official UKPSC website at psc.uk.gov.in or pscuk.net.in.
Navigate to the Menubar and click on "How to Apply", view Advertisement Details, Important Dates, and Instructions, then click "Apply Now".
Fill in correct basic information, generate a password, and click Submit to view Basic Information.
Verify all details, tick the declaration box ("I have verified all the details entered by me in the registration form and wish to submit the same"), and submit.
Note primary registration confirmation and receive login details via SMS and email.
Log in, fill in High School, Intermediate, Graduate, and other educational details, add them to the grid, fill other details, and continue.
Upload scanned passport-size photograph and signature as per instructions.
Tick the declaration ("I hereby declare that the photograph & signature are correct and accurate representation of myself") and continue to review data.
Check all details carefully, tick the final declaration, and complete the online application process by clicking the Final Button, then print the application.
Pay the application fee through Net Banking, Debit Card, Credit Card, or UPI by 26 November 2026 (11:59:59 PM).

content_sections.heading: UKPSC Eligibility Criteria 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates must fulfill the educational qualifications, nationality, and other mandatory conditions prescribed by the Commission as of the last date of online application. Educational Domicile: Candidates must have passed their High School and Intermediate or equivalent examinations from recognized institutions situated within the State of Uttarakhand (with specific exemptions for regular employees of central/state governments, semi-government organizations, public sector undertakings, or armed/paramilitary forces serving in Uttarakhand whose services are non-transferable outside Uttarakhand, and permanent residents living outside the state for livelihood or education). Employment Exchange Registration: The candidate's name must be registered in any District Employment Office located within the State of Uttarakhand up to the last date of application receipt (exempted for those already employed under the State Government of Uttarakhand). Preferential Qualifications: Service in the Territorial Army for a minimum of 2 years, or holding an NCC 'B' or 'C' certificate (or NSS 'C' certificate for Supply Inspector), carries weightage in direct recruitment where candidates have equal marks.

faq.question: Q1. What is UKPSC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: UKPSC Recruitment 2026 is the Uttarakhand Combined State (Civil) Lower Subordinate Services Examination conducted by the Uttarakhand Public Service Commission to fill 54 vacancies across multiple administrative and departmental posts.

faq.question: Q2. How many total vacancies are announced in UKPSC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 54 vacancies have been announced for posts including Nayab Tehsildar, Excise Inspector, Supply Inspector, Marketing Inspector, Labour Enforcement Officer, Tax Officer Zila Panchayat, Senior Cane Development Inspector, and Cane Development Inspector.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for UKPSC Lower Subordinate Exam 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit online applications and pay the application fee is 26 November 2026 up to 11:59:59 PM.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for UKPSC Lower Subordinate Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must be between 21 and 42 years of age as on 01 July 2026, with relaxations applicable for reserved categories as per government rules.

faq.question: Q5. What is the educational qualification required for Nayab Tehsildar?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a Bachelor's degree from a university established by law in India or possess an equivalent educational qualification recognized by the Government.

faq.question: Q6. Is there an application fee for UKPSC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Yes, the total fee is Rs. 166.36 for Unreserved, EWS, and OBC candidates, Rs. 76.36 for SC, ST, and PwD candidates, while eligible orphan children residing in state/voluntary homes in Uttarakhand are exempt from fee payment.

faq.question: Q7. When is the application correction window open?
faq.answer: The online application correction window will remain open from 03 December 2026 to 12 December 2026 (up to 11:59:59 PM).

faq.question: Q8. What are the stages of the selection process?
faq.answer: The selection process comprises a Preliminary Examination (Objective Type), a Main Examination (Descriptive Type), and a Personality Test (Interview).

faq.question: Q9. Where can I download the official notification PDF?
faq.answer: Candidates can download the official notification PDF directly from the UKPSC official website at psc.uk.gov.in.
